articles.title: QB recruit Bo Bryan, son of country star Luke Bryan, commits to Georgia
articles.summary: Class of 2027 quarterback Bo Bryan, the son of country music star Luke Bryan, announced his commitment to Georgia on Sunday.

articles.title: Gamecocks fined $500K after fans rush field in win over Vols
articles.summary: The Southeastern Conference fined South Carolina $500,000 on Sunday for allowing fans to storm the field following a 27-24 victory over then-No. 11 Tennessee.

articles.title: Sources: Texas' Trevor Goosby has season-ending knee injury
articles.summary: Texas star left tackle Trevor Goosby will miss the rest of the season after suffering a knee injury vs. Ole Miss, sources told ESPN's Pete Thamel on Sunday.

articles.title: Missouri RB Ahmad Hardy to practice for first time since getting shot
articles.summary: Missouri consensus All-America RB Ahmad Hardy, who was shot at a concert in May and has yet to play this season, will return to practice this week.

articles.title: Texas soars, BYU and Texas Tech fall in latest AP Top 25 rankings
articles.summary: Seven ranked college football teams lost in Week 8, with five of them coming against unranked foes. Here’s what you need to know about the latest AP Top 25 Poll.

articles.title: Dale Brown, LSU's winningest basketball coach, dies at 90
articles.summary: Dale Brown, who coached LSU to two Final Four appearances and whose players included Shaquille O'Neal and Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf, has died at the age of 90.

articles.title: Ole Miss served most punishments past two seasons for ex-assistant's violations
articles.summary: The NCAA has penalized Ole Miss' men's basketball program for tampering violations by former assistant coach Wes Flanigan, with most of the penalties served during the 2024-25 and 2025-26 school years.

articles.title: Paul Finebaum remembers former LSU coach Dale Brown
Spartans' Fears, Gators' Haugh near-unanimous picks as preseason All-Americans
articles.summary: Florida's Thomas Haugh and Michigan State's Jeremy Fears Jr. returned to make their teams among the front-runners to cut down the nets next spring and earned them preseason All-America honors from The Associated Press.

articles.title: Brandon Woodruff's lone NCAA baseball tournament appearance in 2014
articles.summary: Brandon Woodruff — two-time MLB All-Star with the Milwaukee Brewers — pitched at Mississippi State from 2012-14 and made one appearance in the NCAA baseball tournament in 2014.

articles.title: Florida an overwhelming No. 1 in preseason AP Top 25 men's basketball poll
articles.summary: The Florida Gators are an overwhelming choice as the No. 1 team in the Associated Press preseason men's basketball poll released Monday.

articles.title: Breaking down the men's 2026-27 AP preseason Top 25 basketball poll
articles.summary: Biggest games and projected starting lineups for the AP preseason Top 25, from No. 1 Florida to No. 25 BYU.

articles.title: Miami rises to No. 1, Texas and Alabama plummet in latest AP poll
articles.summary: Fourteen ranked college football teams lost in Week 7, with five of them being in the AP poll's top eight. Here’s what you need to know about the latest AP Top 25 Poll.

articles.title: Auburn upsets No. 1 Georgia with walk-off field goal
articles.summary: For the first time since October 1990, the No. 1 team in the country has lost in back-to-back weeks. No. 1 Georgia is the latest top-ranked team to fall after Auburn made a 34-yard field goal to win 27-24.
